text:
BUYER QUALIFICATION WORKFLOW
PROCUREMENT SUPPORT FOR BITUMEN BUYERS

LAST REVIEWED SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 · PETROBIND EXPORT DESK

A serious bitumen RFQ needs more than a price. Buyers need grade clarity, document support, packing suitability, destination planning, and one accountable team willing to keep the transaction visible.

Request Bitumen Quote
View Bitumen Grades
WHAT TO INCLUDE IN A STRONG BITUMEN RFQ

The fastest RFQs include product category, grade, quantity, monthly requirement if any, packing preference, destination port, Incoterm, delivery window, and any tender-specific test method or documentation requirement.

HOW PETROBIND BUILDS CONFIDENCE

PetroBind works as a principal trading desk, not a blind marketplace. We align the buyer request to available supply, ask the practical questions early, and present the trade path clearly before commitment.

Grade matching across penetration bitumen, VG grades, PMB, oxidized bitumen, and emulsions.

COA/PDS review for qualification before shipment approval.

Packing and route selection by destination handling capability.

Commercial terms reviewed against Incoterm, timeline, payment method, and documentation.

FROM OPPORTUNITY TO TRANSACTION

The goal is not to push a quick sale. The goal is to build repeatable trust: a buyer sends a requirement, PetroBind qualifies the route, both sides understand the risk, and the transaction proceeds only when the product and paperwork make sense.
